source_text: Βουληϑέντι σοι zart ἀχρίβειαν ἐχμαϑεῖν τὰ προτεϑέντα ὑπι σοῦ ἡμῖν κεφάλαια, ἀγαπητέ μου ἀδελφὲ Θεόφιλε, εὔλογον ἡγησάμην, ἀφϑόνως ἀρυσάμενος ὡς ἐὲ ἁγίας πηγῆς ἐξ αὐτῶν τῶν ϑείων γραφῶν καταστῆσαί σοι κατ᾽ ὀφϑαλμὸν τὰ ζητούμενα" ἵνα μὴ μόνον ταῖς τῶν ὥτων ἀχοαῖς ἐγκαταϑέμενος ταῦτα εὐφρανϑῆς, ἀλλὰ δυνάμει καὶ αὐτὰ τὰ πράγϊματα ἐνιστορήσας κατὰ πάντα τὸν ϑεὸν δοξάσαι δυνηϑῆς. τοῦτο γάρ σοι ἐφόϊδιον ἐν τῷ νῦν βίῳ ἀκίνδυνον ἤτω παρ᾽ ἡμῶν, ὅπως τὰ τοῖς πολλοῖς δύσγνωστα καὶ δυσχατάλημπτα ἐξ ἕτοίμῶν λόγων προενέγκας. ἐγκατασπείρης μὲν ἐν τῷ πλάτει τῆς καρδίας σου ὡς ἐν πίονι καὶ καϑαρᾷ γῇ, δυσωπήσῃς δὲ di αὐτῶν τοὺς ἀντιδιατιϑεμένους καὶ ἀντιλέγοντας τῷ σωτηρίῳ λόγῳ. δέδια δὲ μὴ εἰς ἀπίστους καὶ βλασφήμους γλώσοας ἐγκαταϑῇ ταῦτα, κίνδυνος γὰρ οὐχ ὁ τυχών᾽ μετᾶδος δὲ αὐτὰ εὐλαβέσι καὶ πιστοῖς ἀνϑρώποις τοῖς ϑέλουσιν., "ὁσίως xal δικαίως“ μετὰ φόβου ζῆν. οὐ γὰρ μάτην ὃ μακάριος ἀπόστολος παρήνει Τιμοϑέῳ γράφων" »,0 Ti ἐμόϑεε, τὴν παραϑήχην φύλαξον, ἐκτρεπόμενος τὰς βεβήλους κενοφωνίας καὶ ἀντιϑέσεις τῆς ψευδωνύμου γνώσεως, ἣν τινες ἐπαγγελλόμενοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν ἡστόχησα»"" καὶ πάλιν" ,,σὺ οὗν, τέχγον μοῦ, ἐνδυναμοῦ ἐν τῇ χάριτι τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἃ ἤχουσας παρ᾽ ἐμοῦ διὰ πολλῶν μαρτύρων, ταῦτα παράϑου πιστοῖς ἀνϑρώποις, οἵτινες ἱκανοὶ ἔσονται καὶ ἑτέρους διδάξαι".
pass_a_gloss: Having willed that you learn accuracy concerning the chapters proposed by you to us, my beloved brother Theophile, I considered it reasonable, having drawn abundantly as from a holy spring from the divine scriptures themselves, to place before your eyes the things being sought, so that not only by the hearings of the ears might you be gladdened, but also, having been instructed by the power of the things themselves, you might be able to glorify God in every way. For this shall be a safeguard for you in the present life, free from danger, that you, having brought forth from prepared words the things difficult to know and hard to grasp for many, might sow them in the breadth of your heart as in fertile and pure land, and might overthrow those who contradict and speak against the saving word. But be afraid lest these things be entrusted to unbelieving and blaspheming tongues, for the danger is not random, but rather entrust them to cautious and faithful men who wish to live holily and righteously with fear. For not in vain did the blessed apostle warn Timothy, writing: 'Be mindful of the deposit, turning away from profane and empty talk and the contradictions of the falsely named knowledge, which some, promising about the faith, have missed the mark.' And again: 'You, therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus, and the things you heard from me through many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men, who will be sufficient also to teach others.'
pass_b_english: Since you wanted to learn accurately the topics you proposed to us, my beloved brother Theophilus, I considered it right to set before your eyes the matters you seek, drawing abundantly from the divine Scriptures as from a holy spring, so that you might rejoice not only by hearing with your ears, but also, having been instructed by the power of the realities themselves, you might be able to glorify God in every way. For this will be a safeguard for you in the present life, free from danger, that you may bring forth from prepared words the things hard for many to know and hard to grasp, sow them in the breadth of your heart as in fertile and pure soil, and overthrow those who contradict and speak against the saving word. But be afraid lest these things be entrusted to unbelieving and blaspheming tongues, for the danger is no ordinary one; rather entrust them to cautious and faithful men who wish to live holily and righteously with fear. For not in vain did the blessed apostle warn Timothy, writing: "Guard the deposit, turning away from profane and empty talk and the contradictions of the falsely named knowledge, which some, by professing it, have missed the faith" (2 Timothy 1:14). And again: "You, therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus, and what you heard from me through many witnesses entrust to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also" (2 Timothy 2:2).

Scripture citations in Pass B (2 Timothy 1:14 and 2 Timothy 2:2) correctly identify the quoted/alluded passages in the Greek. Pass A and Pass B are consistent with the source.
